## Goal
Lock in the security properties of the infrastructure so no later PR can silently weaken them.

## Owns
- `infra/cdk/test/**`

## Tests first (write them, see them fail, then implement)
- TenantDataRole: dynamodb actions only with LeadingKeys TENANT#${aws:PrincipalTag/tenant_id}; trust has sts:TagSession.
- No IAM statement grants dynamodb:* or s3:* on the tenant table/bucket without a condition.
- Audit bucket has Object Lock; tenant bucket blocks public access and enforces SSL.
- WhatsApp route absent unless enableWhatsApp=true.

## Steps
- Use aws-cdk-lib/assertions Template.fromStack on each stack.

## Acceptance
- Tests run in CI under the typescript job.

## Run
`pnpm vitest run infra/cdk/test` and `make test` before opening the PR.
